blocks.name: Future Trunks, Super Saiyan - playable fighter
blocks.notes: Super Saiyan Future Trunks (golden hair, green eyes). Same grid as future_trunks.png for cols 0-31 and 36-55: Cells are 32x32 on the #47ffbb/#34bc88 checker; the surround #2a966c and the empty-cell border #237f5a are background. The RIGHT row is the horizontal mirror of the LEFT row (the build dedupes it). Up col 1 is empty (no back-view blink). Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk, 6-9 run, 10-13 / 14-17 / 18-21 the three melee strings (wind-up, hit with white swoosh, follow-through, recover; the third string is a spinning kick, so punch3 and kick share 18-21), 22-28 sword charged melee (22 reach for the hilt, 23 draw with an arc trail, 24 blade held low, 25-26 leap with the sword overhead - no baked shadow, 27 downward cleave with a big arc, 28 blade resting on the ground), 29 ki wind-up (body twisted back), 30/31 alternate-hand palm thrusts (loop 30-31 for rapid fire), Cols 32-35 are pixel-identical copies of 10-13 (the first melee string) - this form has no quick-draw special cell, so they are not exported. 36 hit flinch (eyes shut, white hit spark at the head), 37-38 crouched guard behind raised fists (37 carries the block spark, 38 is the held pose), 39 fists-clenched power-up stance (the engine aura goes on top), 40-43 the level-up / emote slot (40-41 with white sparkles, 42-43 without; 41 and 43 are both hands on the head from the front and a hand rubbing the back of the head from the side - a sheepish head scratch; same slot as goku.json levelUp), 44-47 level flight with the whole body drawn (feet trailing behind/above the head, hair fluttering; no baked shadow), 48-51 diagonal flight (no baked shadow): the DOWN row flies down-right, LEFT row down-left, RIGHT row up-left and UP row up-right (back views), exported as flyDownRight / flyDownLeft / flyUpLeft / flyUpRight with the single sheet row each uses, 52-55 knock-down in the side rows only (52 doubled over, 53 falling onto the hands, 54-55 flat on the ground). Down-row 52 = standing with hands on the hips, down-row 53 = both arms raised straight up (the only 'raise' cell, so raise is front-facing only). The knock-down cells 53-55 already show the hair reverted to lavender (he drops out of Super Saiyan when knocked out); 53 mixes both ramps. Down-only cells: 52 hands on hips, 53 arms raised, 54-57 powering down (54-55 eyes shut with arms relaxed outward, 56 hair fading from gold to lavender, 57 base-form hair) - pair with futureTrunks for the rest of the scene. Cols 56-57 hold only the down row. Cells with no baked shadow: 25-26, 44-51. Palette: #ad7b39 is the golden-hair outline and also a skin shade on hands/face in a few cells; 'hairBase' is the lavender ramp of the knock-down / power-down cells; white is shared by hair highlights, eyes, blade and effects.
